objective_value: <float> Total cost of the distribution plan, equal to the sum of all vehicle travel costs and end-of-period holding costs at the depot and all customers across the planning horizon.

{vehicle}.route: <list[int]> Ordered sequence of location indices traversed by this vehicle in this period, starting and ending at the depot (index 0).
{vehicle}.deliveries: <dict, key: '{customer}'> Quantity of the commodity delivered by this vehicle to each customer it visits in this period.

inventories.{location}: <dict, key: '{period}'> Inventory on hand at this location (depot or customer) at the end of each period.
